steps.name: Locate
steps.title: Find the annotated region
steps.text: The crosshairs mark a voxel inside the selected reference label. The same location appears in all three slices and in the registered 3D view. This is a dataset annotation, not a diagnosis made by RxAtlas.

steps.name: Compare
steps.title: Separate image signal from the label
steps.text: Each slice shows the original MRI signal on the left and the supplied annotation overlay on the right. Changing display brightness or color does not change the underlying segmentation.

steps.name: Measure
steps.title: Inspect the mask and its volume
steps.text: Only the selected class is shown in 3D. Volume is calculated by counting its native labeled voxels and multiplying by calibrated voxel volume. The surface is a visualization of the mask, not the source of the measurement.

steps.name: Context
steps.title: Return to the whole case
steps.text: The surrounding MRI and other supplied labels help place this finding in context. These colors describe annotation classes; they do not establish tumor grade or select a treatment.

steps.name: Limits
steps.title: Know what this case cannot tell us
steps.text: The overlay is removed so you can inspect the signal alone. No confidence map, lobe localization, clinical history, or AI interpretation is supplied. Reference annotations can have uncertainty; no numerical confidence is invented.
